summary: Iter 628 (Paket 31) — 4 features tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter628_paket31.py covering (1) Guest Pass: GET /api/guest-pass/MHB-A8502A2D returns hotel.name='Franziskaner by Centra', 2 extras, wallet.apple_ready=false + google_ready=false; wrong email → 404; qr.png → PNG magic bytes; calendar.ics contains BEGIN:VEVENT and DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20261026; apple.pkpass → 503, google → 503 without certs. Wallet-settings PUT with apple_pass_type_id+apple_cert_pem → apple_cert_present=true, guest-pass now shows apple_ready=true, apple.pkpass returns 501 (not implemented). Clearing apple_pass_type_id='' flips apple_ready back to false. (2) e-Fatura archive: GET /api/tr-compliance/efatura/default/archive.zip?month=2026-09 → 200 application/zip; unzip contains ozet_2026-09.csv (BOM+UTF8, header starts with 'invoice_no,'), pdf/*.pdf (start with %PDF-) and xml/*.xml (well-formed); month=2031-01 → 404, month='bad' → 422. (3) Campaign A/B: fresh session GET /api/site-builder/public/c/QANOW10?ch=email → 302 Location ends with &v=A or &v=B, Set-Cookie abv_QANOW10 present; second call in same session is sticky (same variant); over 20 fresh sessions both A and B observed. POST /public/track {event:view|cta_click, variant:'B'} accepted. GET /campaign-stats returns {campaigns:[...]}: QANOW10.ab has A/B with clicks/views/cta/cta_rate_pct, leader, winner='', active=true. POST /campaign-ab/QANOW10/apply-winner {winner:'B'} → ok; verified title='Şimdi rezerve et, %10 kazan!', title_b='', ab_winner='B'. Site content restored via POST /site-builder/default: title='Aktif Kampanya', title_b='Şimdi rezerve et, %10 kazan!'. (4) HK issue create: POST /api/maintenance/issues with photos_before + source=hk_mobile → 201 with id. Frontend Playwright verified: (a) /pass/MHB-A8502A2D?email=qa.upsell2 at 390x844 renders guest-pass-page, guest-pass-hotel='Franziskaner by Centra', guest-pass-ref='MHB-A8502A2D', QR img URL correct, 2 extras rows (+heading), Apple/Google buttons show 'yakında' with disabled styling, click on apple triggers alert dialog 'Bu cüzdan bağlantısı için otel yönetimi sertifika/anahtar tanımlamalı.', ics href ends with calendar.ics. Wrong email → guest-pass-error 'Rezervasyon bulunamadı'. (b) Site Builder → Blog & Kampanyalar: 2 AB rows site-post-ab-0 (QAWIN20) and site-post-ab-1 (QANOW10); site-post-title-b-1 value='Şimdi rezerve et, %10 kazan!'; variant boxes site-post-ab-1-A / -1-B and apply buttons site-post-ab-apply-1-A / -B present (not clicked). site-post-short-0/-1 present. (c) Finance → e-Fatura panel: tr-efatura-bulk-month set to 2026-09, click tr-efatura-archive triggered download event 'efatura_default_2026-09.zip'. (d) /hk-mobile/default: hk-login flow works; go offline → hk-room-104 opens sheet → hk-issue-open text contains '(çevrimdışı)', hk-issue-cat-plumbing + hk-issue-note='Duş akıtıyor' + hk-issue-submit text='Cihazda sakla' → hk-issue-queue-bar '🔧 1 arıza bildirimi gönderilmeyi bekliyor', localStorage hk-issues-default has 1 item with full payload. Reload offline → bar persists. Go online → within 1.5s toast '1 arıza bildirimi gönderildi', bar disappears, localStorage empty; verified backend GET /api/maintenance/issues/default now has 'Oda 104 — Tesisat' as newest issue.

minor.issue: create_issue does not persist 'source' or 'offline_reported_at' fields from the request payload; the persisted document has source=None despite hk_mobile client sending source='hk_mobile'. HK mobile audit trail is thus incomplete. Consider adding: issue['source'] = data.get('source','') and issue['offline_reported_at'] = data.get('offline_reported_at','').

action_items: (Minor) In routes/hotel_ops/maintenance.py create_issue, persist 'source' and 'offline_reported_at' fields sent by HK-mobile PWA — currently silently dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: guest_pass.pass_data — computes wallet.apple_ready = bool(apple_cert_present AND apple_pass_type_id). Clearing pass_type_id keeps cert_present=True in DB indefinitely; adding a UI to 'delete cert' would be safer.

guest_pass.calendar.ics — DTSTART/DTEND use DATE (not DATETIME) form; multi-day stays render as all-day events which is fine, but the DESCRIPTION concatenates raw address without escaping commas/semicolons/newlines per RFC 5545. If a hotel name or extras contain ',' or ';' calendar apps may parse fields wrong.

tr_compliance.efatura_archive — reads up to 2000 invoices and renders all PDFs synchronously (reportlab) inside the request. For a large month this can time-out. Consider streaming ZIP or Celery/background job.

site_builder.campaign_short_link — assigns variant with random.choice(); no seeding on visitor_id, so a repeat visitor without cookie (e.g. private/incognito) can flip variants. Consider hashing IP+UA for sticky-across-sessions variance if needed.

site_builder.campaign_apply_winner — clears title_b unconditionally on apply, but variant clicks from campaign_clicks history remain tagged 'B' etc. Stats still show ab block because ab_winner is truthy; UI should treat ab.active=false as read-only.

maintenance.create_issue drops client-supplied fields 'source' and 'offline_reported_at' — offline reports lose their provenance. Also no validation on photos_before size/count → data:image base64 can be up to 10MB each.
seed_data_creation: Backend test toggled wallet_settings.default apple_pass_type_id/cert on then off; final state: apple_cert_present=True but apple_pass_type_id='' (apple_ready=false). Site content: applied winner B for QANOW10 then restored via POST /site-builder/default — final title='Aktif Kampanya', title_b='Şimdi rezerve et, %10 kazan!', but ab_winner may remain 'B' on the persisted post (only title/title_b restored in the POST payload; server strips fields not in whitelist so ab_winner is dropped and re-set to blank by save_site). Verified via API: title/title_b correct. campaign_clicks collection got ~10 new rows from A/B stickiness tests. HK Playwright flow created 1 real maintenance issue 'Oda 104 — Tesisat' for property default via /api/maintenance/issues (this is a live record).

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found; one minor code polish: maintenance create_issue silently drops 'source' and 'offline_reported_at' fields from the payload. HK-mobile client (HousekeepingMobilePWA.js OfflineIssueReporter) sends source='hk_mobile' in every queued item, but the server persists it as None. Fix: extend the issue dict at line 91 of /app/backend/routes/hotel_ops/maintenance.py with 'source': data.get('source',''), 'offline_reported_at': data.get('offline_reported_at','').
